### (a) Data source chosen: official House Clerk disclosures — and why

**Chosen:** `disclosures-clerk.house.gov` (public government data, no auth, no keys, no ToS friction):
- Year index: `https://disclosures-clerk.house.gov/public_disc/financial-pdfs/<YEAR>FD.zip` → `<YEAR>FD.xml`, one `<Member>` per filing; `FilingType=P` = PTR. Verified live: Last-Modified **today** (2026-07-27 13:00 UTC), 52 KB, 318 PTR filings in 2026, two Pelosi PTRs (DocIDs 20033725, 20034836).
- PTR PDFs: `https://disclosures-clerk.house.gov/public_disc/ptr-pdfs/<YEAR>/<DocID>.pdf`.

The PDFs are RC4-128 "permissions" encrypted (empty user password) with CID fonts, so no off-the-shelf text dump works with stdlib — I embedded a ~150-line stdlib-only extractor (MD5 key derivation + RC4 + FlateDecode + ToUnicode CMap decode) in `congress_feed.py`, **verified end-to-end against both live Pelosi 2026 PTRs**: Jan filing (AB, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, VST buys; AAPL/AMZN/NVDA/GOOGL partial sells; PYPL/DIS full sells) and June filing (INTC calls $1M–$5M, UBER calls $500K–$1M).

**Rejected candidates (all probed today):**
- housestockwatcher.com / senatestockwatcher.com S3 JSON — **dead**: both buckets return AccessDenied; project unmaintained.
- capitoltrades.com `bff` API — returned CloudFront 503; unofficial and ToS-murky anyway.
- Quiver Quantitative — congress endpoints sit behind paid API tiers.
- efdsearch.senate.gov — Senate only (Pelosi is House); needs a CSRF/session dance; deliberately not implemented — Senators in the config are ignored, never guessed at.

**Latency caveat:** the STOCK Act permits up to 30/45 days between trade and disclosure; the June PTR disclosed May 29 trades on June 23 (25-day lag). The feed is as fresh as the filing, never fresher. Index itself updates daily.

### (b) Composition heuristic (config-overridable via `state/congress_feed_config.json`)

Chronological replay of parsed transactions from `politicians` (default `["Nancy Pelosi"]`) over the last `lookback_days=365`, deduped across amendments:
- **Buy (P):** add amount-range midpoint dollars, decayed by `2^(-age_days/half_life_days)` (`half_life_days=180`); open-ended "Over $X" brackets use 1.5·X
- **Full sale (S):** drop the symbol; **partial sale:** multiply by `partial_sale_factor=0.5`; **exchange (E):** ignore
- Options `[OP]` count as underlying exposure (`include_options=true` — Pelosi's book is mostly LEAPS)
- Keep top `max_positions=12`, normalize to weights summing to 1

Fail-closed throughout: index fetch failure, any new-PDF fetch/parse failure, or an unfetched backlog (>10 new PDFs/tick politeness cap) leaves the previous holdings file untouched.
